details.publicNotes:
The spiritflame lantern is a symphony of spirits bound within a silver lantern. These lanterns are adorned with ornate figures that echo the appearances the spirits once held in life, which constantly morph and dance in tune with the restless fire. As the lantern moves, they emit an eerie, melodic hum reminiscent of distant chants and forgotten lullabies.

Spiritflame lanterns form when tattered souls are ensnared through a foul ritual that amalgamates them together with a concoction of silver, black onyx, and unholy fire. The imprisoned spirits seek out places stained with memories of death, hoping to collect fragments of lost souls to join them in their prison. Each time a new spirit is bound, the spirits within surge free, if only for a moment. This experience gives each spirit hope that someday, if they doom enough to their wretched fate, they will finally be able to escape to the afterlife.

When someone dies within the lantern's light, the spiritflame lantern tears off a tiny piece of their soul and holds it fast. While this loss does not prevent the deceased from being restored to life, it leaves them plagued by nightmares of confinement and flames. Only the lantern's destruction can release all bound within, but the spirits are seldom willing to contemplate this course, for they believe that shattering the lantern will mean their annihilation. Instead, they believe that if they doom enough souls, the lantern will be satisfied with their efforts and release them.

Burning Hatred

Spiritflame lanterns fear and despise vigil flames on an instinctual level. The intensity of this innate loathing has led many ritual scholars to speculate that the process for a spiritflame lantern's creation might have been designed as a perversion of the process that allows vigil flames to be born.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 12/27/50 gp

Eligible Refinements perception item, skill items (Acrobatics, Intimidation, Occultism, Religion, Stealth)

Eligible Imbued Properties burning barbs, charisma, death, dexterity, energy resistant (acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, void), fire, fire shield, sensory (darkvision), spirit, throwing, unholy, wild, winged, wisdom

description.value: The spiritflame lantern emits a soft, ghostly radiance, casting dim light in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. This illumination is magical and can't be extinguished by non-magical means.

The spiritflame lantern unleashes a bright burst of ethereal flames in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. All creatures within the area take @Damage[1d8[fire],1d8[void]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save). Creatures who fail the saving throw are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

The spiritflame lantern focuses their spectral energy into a concentrated beam. The imprisoned spirits relish a brief taste of freedom as they surge forth, clinging to whomever they reach. Each creature in a @Template[type:line|distance:60] must roll a @Check[reflex|dc:21] save. The spiritflame lantern can't use Spiritflame Beam again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Spiritflame Beam]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[1d12[fire]|options:area-damage] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[1d12[fire],3[persistent,fire],1d12[void]|options:area-damage] damage. It is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} and can't reduce or remove this condition until it removes the persistent fire damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[2d12[fire],3[persistent,fire],2d12[void],3[persistent,void]|options:area-damage]. It is frightened 1 and can't reduce or remove this condition until it removes the persistent fire and void damage.
